gjort: Budget round: main campaign CARASHELL_SE_Taköverdraget raised 3 400 → 4 000 kr/day. The store turned back up — 3-day profit 32.1 % and ROAS 3.42, against 19.3 % and 2.38 last night. 47 purchases over 7 days
The LISTICLE campaign stays at 1 200 kr: it is in scaling territory (profit 25.9 %) but the cadence lock wants 3 days between changes and it was raised yesterday. It will be eligible again on Monday
Nothing paused, nothing activated, no ad killed. Profit contribution across judgeable ads is now 13 561 kr over 14 days

No brief day (Saturday) — and the brief round is paused anyway: CaraShell is no longer briefed on its own, everything is created in the Bäverbutiken teamspace and mirrored here. The budget round keeps running every night
varningar: The LISTICLE campaign's ROAS eased from 3.19 to 2.82 as its budget went up — still well above break-even 1.63 and still profitable, but it is the number to watch when the cadence lock opens on Monday
